cands.name: Wancito Francius
cands.bio: Republican candidate for Florida House District 108. His campaign site calls him a lifelong resident of the district and a community advocate. Career and prior offices not found.

record.text: Campaign site promotes a proposed 'Nathan Emmanuel Francius Autism Support and Resources Act' ($8 million from General Revenue for school autism evaluations, behavior technicians and school tools). The site gives no bill number and does not say whether it was filed.

cands.name: Daphne Campbell
cands.bio: Registered nurse (BSN). Florida House District 108, 2010-2016; Florida Senate District 38, 2016-2018. Lost the 2018 Senate primary to Jason Pizzo. Won the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary for HD 108.
cands.local_ties: Born in Cap-Haitien, Haiti (1957). Haitian-American; represented northeast Miami-Dade for most of 2010-2018. Ran for North Miami mayor in 2024 per BallotReady. Current residence not stated in sources found.

record.text: Florida House, District 108, three terms 2010-2016; Florida Senate, District 38, 2016-2018 (Wikipedia).
Other races: Senate District 35 Democratic primary 2020 (placed second per Wikipedia); North Miami mayor 2024 general per BallotReady.
Campaign site says she secured $3.7M in local project funding, '$125M+' for District 38 and $25M for cancer research; these are the campaign's own claims, not independently verified.

controversies.text: Wikipedia reports that in 2012 the IRS investigated her family business and placed liens totaling $145,000 on her and her husband after former business partners alleged they had scammed them; it says she denied the liens existed when questioned by the Tampa Bay Times.
Wikipedia reports the state cut funding to a group home she and her husband ran after three patients died, one was raped and others lived in squalor.

Florida Politics reported her campaign apologized for falsely claiming the endorsement of an Aventura city commissioner (article date not verified; headlines seen in search results, full article not read).

cands.gaps: No hits on the owner-designated sites in a single site: search (returned only mainstream coverage); search index may not cover them, and the specific rumble.com/c/StewPeters, rumble.com/TheAlexJonesShowLive and rumble.com/Owen channel pages were not individually checked. Donors, committees and endorsements not found. Primary vote percentage (Wikipedia says 46.1%) not independently confirmed. Wikipedia details above are secondhand summaries of older reporting; 2017-18 incidents (FPL power call, police called on reporters) omitted for space.
